# UnityDecompiled

Unofficial decompiled source mirror of Unity editor and engine assemblies (00christian00). Generated with [[ilspy]] from a Unity 5.x release; ships a large C# codebase and solution files that expose internal APIs and editor behavior for offline study. Mainly useful for engine reverse engineering, tooling research, and compatibility analysis—not a runtime cheat artifact. README lane `[An unofficial repo of decompiled Unity dll files]`. (source: wiki/sources/descriptions/00christian00__UnityDecompiled.md)

Complements official managed reference [[unity-cs-reference]] with a legacy-version ILSpy reconstruction when studying editor/engine internals outside live debugging via [[dnspy]] or runtime inspection via [[unityexplorer]].
